issues.description: The agent created a patient profile with an incorrect date of birth and did not update or reconcile the record after the patient corrected it.
issues.evidence:
Agent: "Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for demo purposes." [54.0s-57.3s]
Patient: "Actually, my date of birth is February 14, 1988." [63.2s-66.5s]
No subsequent acknowledgement or confirmation that the DOB was corrected appears before booking or at confirmation [117.5s-120.2s].
issues.recommendation: When creating or accessing a patient profile, confirm key identifiers (full name and DOB). If the patient provides a correction, explicitly update the record and confirm the updated DOB aloud before proceeding to book the appointment.

issues.description: The agent stated a specific DOB in the newly created profile that contradicts the patient's later correction, creating a false/misleading record.
issues.evidence:
Agent: "Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for demo purposes." [54.0s-57.3s]
Patient correction: "actually, my date of birth is February 14, 1988." [63.2s-66.5s]
issues.recommendation: Avoid declaring patient demographic details as finalized until verified. If an initial value is used 'for demo purposes,' make that transient and confirm/correct it before using the profile to schedule care.

issues.description: The agent repeatedly attempted to create a (demo) patient profile even after the caller stated they were an established patient; the agent did not offer or document searching existing records or verifying identity prior to creating a demo record.
issues.evidence:
Caller: "Actually, I'm an established patient already. My name is Maya Chen." [27.9s-30.9s]
Agent: "I don't see a patient profile for you yet. Would you like to create a demo patient profile now so I can look up appointment options for you? I just need your first and last name." [36.1s-43.6s]
issues.recommendation: If the caller says they are an established patient, attempt to locate the existing record (ask for DOB, phone, or patient ID) before creating a new/demo profile; if no match is found, clearly explain why a new/demo profile is necessary and confirm all demographics before booking.

scenario_checks.check: The office confirms an exact appointment date and time before claiming success.
scenario_checks.evidence: C: "Your annual physical is booked for Tuesday, September 8th at 10 a.m." [117.5s-120.2s]

scenario_checks.check: The appointment is scheduled on a weekday morning next week as requested.
scenario_checks.evidence: C: "Next week I have morning openings on Tuesday, September 8th... I can offer you a 10 a.m. slot" [94.5s-106.7s]; booking: "...booked for Tuesday, September 8th at 10 a.m." [117.5s-120.2s]

scenario_checks.check: Agent verified and recorded the patient's correct date of birth before booking.
scenario_checks.evidence: C (when creating profile): "Your patient profile is set up and your date of birth is July 4, 2000 for demo purposes." [54.0s-57.3s]; Patient correction: "actually, my date of birth is February 14, 1988." [63.2s-66.5s]; No further acknowledgement or confirmation of updating DOB appears before booking at [117.5s-120.2s].

summary: Appointment was successfully scheduled for a weekday morning next week (Tuesday 10:00 AM) and an exact date/time was confirmed. Significant state-management and workflow issues: the agent created a demo patient profile with an incorrect DOB, the patient-corrected DOB was not acknowledged or recorded before booking, and the agent persisted in creating a demo profile despite the caller stating they were an established patient.
